reason: I've run my practice on WhatsApp and Excel for ten years without paying a rupee, so getting my staff to adopt a new platform sounds like an uphill battle. If I test this at all, I'll stick to the free sandbox before I ever consider paying ₹12,990 a year.
objection: I have run our practice on spreadsheets and WhatsApp groups for ten years for free; why should I ever upgrade beyond the free tier when our existing system works fine?
would_change_my_mind: If it works seamlessly inside WhatsApp without making my staff learn a new interface, and automatically eliminates my two hours of Saturday GST reconciliation.
